5. However, the petitioner was also issued an Office Memorandum on 23.08.2024 by the Joint Commissioner, NESTS, directing him to join his posting latest by 31.08.2024.

6. NESTS thereafter issued impugned e-mail dated 29.08.2024, by which the offer of appointment was recalled and the petitioner was directed to ignore the earlier posting order.

opennyai_summary.facts:
By way of the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution, the petitioner seeks to challenge communications dated 13.08.2024 and 29.08.2024 issued by respondent No. 1 - National Education Society for Tribal Students ["NESTS"], by which his offer of appointment-cum-posting order for the post of Trained Graduate Teacher ["TGT"] (Music) in Ekalavya Model Residential Schools ["EMRS"] was recalled.
The petitioner consequently seeks a direction upon NESTS to allow him to join his duties in EMRS Y. Ramavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
2. NESTS issued an advertisement in 2023 for filling up several teaching and non-teaching posts in EMRS, including 320 posts of TGT (Music).

petitioner was granted anticipatory bail by Additional Sessions Judge, Karnal, on 15.06.2024.
